name: Hyundai Motor Manufacturing Alabama (HMMA) - Montgomery AL

fieldNotes.site: 1,744-acre HMMA campus (per hmmausa.com / Wikipedia). Operational developed footprint geofenced here is ~620 acres; full owned land much larger. 3.4M sq ft of buildings: stamping, weld, paint, assembly, three engine shops, plus an east logistics/parts warehouse complex and a 2-mile test track at the north edge.
fieldNotes.truckGate: HMMA uses controlled, numbered gates (web research confirms 'Gate 2' as the visitor entrance). Main multi-lane entry off Hyundai Blvd at 32.2769,-86.3253; access control is set back inside the property, standard for a large guarded automotive campus.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred true — large captive-OEM assembly plant with numbered, staffed security gates is industry-standard. A security/check-in structure is visible inside the entry road near the dock-side at ~32.2799,-86.3252. Booth not crisply resolvable at road edge, hence medium-confidence on exact footprint.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer drop yard on the SE/east side off Hyundai Blvd (~32.2788,-86.3145) holding ~80-100 trailers, plus extensive trailer rows along the logistics warehouse faces. dropArea 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: East logistics/parts warehouse complex shows long banks of dock doors with trailers backed in on multiple faces; assembly building has additional truck docks. Total across the site comfortably 50+; 90 is an honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus with 12+ distinct large buildings (assembly hall, stamping, paint, three engine shops, multiple logistics warehouses) — clear multi-facility campus.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts logistics warehouses (east complex) are physically separate from the assembly-building shipping docks — distinct dock clusters on different parts of the campus.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Main entry is a wide multi-lane apron with abundant paved width — physical room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Surrounded by farmland and woods on the south edge of Montgomery; rural-edge setting.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified in imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed running into the developed campus footprint.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Honest overhead estimate (~220) across drop yard and warehouse dock faces; counts approximate.
fieldNotes.geofence: Center 32.2812,-86.3235. Perimeter box covers the developed operational footprint (buildings, lots, test track) — the YardFlow-relevant geofence — not the full 1,744-acre land parcel.
